text: China's July industrial profits rose 11.2% YoY, while Jan.-July growth slowed to 17.6%. Integrated-circuit profits rose 18.5% and raw materials 55.2%; furniture profits fell 58.2%. Producer-price growth eased to 3.5%.

meta.note: Aggregate profit growth masks large differences between industrial sectors.

text: Nvidia rose 7.2% premarket as Micron, Marvell, Arm, Intel, AMD, Nebius and CoreWeave also gained. Nvidia projects 70% fiscal 2028 revenue growth while semiconductor manufacturing and memory supply remain constrained.

meta.note: Reported Hugging Face acquisition discussions remain unconfirmed and are excluded from the event.

text: CrowdStrike rose 15% and Okta 20% after both beat quarterly estimates and raised forecasts. Palo Alto Networks, SailPoint and Rubrik gained about 9%. Okta's newer products represented nearly one-third of bookings, while CrowdStrike's flexible Falcon offering doubled YoY.

meta.note: AI-specific revenue remains incompletely disclosed despite broader reported product adoption.

text: Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack supports higher rates after dissenting from the FOMC's July hold at 3.5%-3.75%. She was one of three voting members preferring a 25-basis-point increase; current market pricing favors no change in September or October.

meta.note: The stated policy preference remains outside the FOMC's prevailing rate position.

text: Old Navy comparable sales fell 4% while Gap rose 10%, Banana Republic rose 3%, and Athleta fell 12%. Michael Francis becomes Old Navy CEO Nov. 2 as Haio Barbeito shifts to advisor. Gap narrowed full-year sales growth guidance to 1%-1.5%.

meta.note: Leadership transfer is scheduled but not yet operational.
